verdict.rationale: Docs cover the full loop for document-plus-selfie checks. Sessions are created server-side, Stripe provides the capture flow, selfies are matched to the ID, and results come back via webhooks or programmatic retrieval. Static flow links show a hosted path, and community users report the desktop-to-phone capture and UX working well in practice. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an embedded/drop-in modal option and of the session redirect URL mechanics; embedding is only implied.
